length_limits.notes: Original Papers up to 7 pages, about 5,000 words excluding figures. Application Notes up to 4 pages, about 2,600 words, or 2,000 words plus one figure. Reviews 3 to 8 pages. A manuscript 20 percent or more over its limit is typically returned without review.

figure_spec.notes: No figure count, resolution, format or colour-mode requirement was found on the pages fetched.

reference_style.style: Not stated on the pages fetched; only dataset citations are specified, following the DataCite recommendations.

submission_steps: submit through ScholarOne at http://mc.manuscriptcentral.com/bioinformatics, which requires an account
a cover letter is mandatory and must justify the fit, disclose related publications and preprints, and say how this differs from them
machine-learning papers need a subsection describing the composition of the training dataset
software papers need an Availability and Implementation section
every paper needs a data availability statement

template.notes: The guidelines reference a journal template and accept Word or LaTeX on acceptance, but no direct no-login download link was found.

license_of_summary_source.statement: The page states that published papers are made available under CC BY through open-access agreements; that is a publishing licence, not a statement about reusing the guidelines text.
